scope: Targeted existing primary source reread, no external execution or new speed measurement
observations: SemiBin2 uses measured abundance in its encoder and intersects raw/learned support before weighted partitioning; does not validate our metric, loss or selection defaults.
SCGBinner uses multiview alignment and SCG-derived contrastive constraints; our conservative physical-call/protein/context guards preserve biological ambiguity, not a claim of identical algorithm.

DCVBin filtered >=2000 bp and used one orientation of one truncated parent, 5000 tokens, one parent per forward. Full E021 parent/crop/both-strand/chunk exposure is a different treatment; no numerical speed advantage was confirmed in the previous paper audit.
publication_fetch_limits: MetaBAT Bitbucket README request timed out; reuse E011 pinned CLI/source/paper audit plus actual native 2.18 help/readers, rather than claim a newly read publisher page.
